about: The owner's speed dial for the loss looks (his notes of 2026-10-02, "total arbitrary estimate of how much I want sped up"). "<kind>/<id>": { "from": a phase the look's def declares (phases: { exit: 0.62 }) or 0 for the whole moment, "x": how many times faster from there, 1 to 3 }. The engine plays the look at its own pace up to that phase, then x times as fast, so it finishes early and the card sits clean until the reel moves on. TODAY'S PACE IS SAVED: delete a line and that look plays exactly as it did before the dial. After an edit: node tools/art-index.js (it writes each line into art-index.js), then the cache-key stamp.
